WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was, p.subcategory AS sub_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.sales_line_id AS id, 'S' AS kind
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net, r.return_line_id, 'R'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, n.cat_was, n.sub_was, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT n.kind||n.id) AS nd
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.cat_was ILIKE '%garden%'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(d.fiscal_period, n.cat_was, n.sub_was)
ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'sales' AS src, p.category, p.subcategory, (f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to) AS version_ok, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) AS net,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id*1000+f.line_no) AS dup_receipt_lines, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dup_ids
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND (p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR p.subcategory ILIKE '%light%')
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', p.category, p.subcategory, (r.return_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to), COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(r.refund_net),2), COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), 0
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND (p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR p.subcategory ILIKE '%light%')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS s999
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, ROUND(m.mine,2) AS mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) AS ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) AS gap, c.s999
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS garden_net_sales
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
